description: Quotes flag globs, =words, and URLs that zsh would expand in Bash commands, sets cshnullglob so a glob with no match drops out when another in the command matched, and explains zsh errors in the result

hooks.command: [ -z "$CLAUDE_ENV_FILE" ] || grep -qs cshnullglob "$CLAUDE_ENV_FILE" || echo 'if [ -n "$ZSH_VERSION" ]; then setopt cshnullglob; fi' >> "$CLAUDE_ENV_FILE"
